data.title: Introducing the SafePal (SFP) Token Sale With a New Binance Launchpad Subscription Format!

For example, if you have an average of 2,000 BNB over the 6 day calculation period, you may commit 2,000 BNB during the subscription period. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"How is my final allocation calculated?"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Once the subscription period is over, each user’s token allocation will be roughly calculated as follows: (Individual committed BNB / Total committed BNB by all participants) * Total SFP tokens to be sold. The final calculation is likely to deviate from this estimation due to the hard cap per user. Users will likely receive a slightly different final allocation than estimated using the formula above. For further information on the exact calculation details, read the article "},{"node":"element","tag":"a","attr":{"href":"https://www.binance.com/en/support/faq/9c9c8c38ce384c95a527f19dd30b7464"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"here"}]},{"node":"text","text":"."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Subscription Timeline:"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Preparation Period"}]},{"node":"text","text":" 2021-02-02 0:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-02-08 0:00 AM (UTC): During this period, user BNB balances will be calculated in "},{"node":"element","tag":"a","attr":{"href":"https://www.binance.com/en/support/articles/360031505011"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"hourly snapshots"}]},{"node":"text","text":" for each day over a 6-day period. Your final average daily BNB balance over these 6 days will determine the maximum amount of BNB that you can commit later on."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Subscription Period"}]},{"node":"text","text":" 2021-02-08 4:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-02-08 8:00 AM (UTC): Subscription will open at this time for all eligible users for a 4 hour period. Users must also sign the Token Purchase Agreement at the same time, prior to committing their BNB. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"locked"}]},{"node":"text","text":" and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Calculation Period"}]},{"node":"text","text":" 2021-02-08 8:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-02-08 9:00 AM (UTC): Subscription closes and token allocation calculation begins."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Final Token Distribution"}]},{"node":"text","text":" 2021-02-08 9:00 AM (UTC): Your final token allocation will be calculated and the corresponding BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount.
